candidate.name: Stiff-Vector Frame with Kinetic-Decoupled Degenerate Khronon (KHD)
candidate.claimed_mechanism: The timelike vector u_mu serves as the preferred-frame lensing carrier (satisfying the DC-013 slip-lock requirement) while possessing a degenerate kinetic sector that enforces it as a second-class variable (zero canonical momentum). This degenerate kinetic term is strictly independent of the MOND screening factor e^-y, thereby satisfying the P7 mandate that the kinetic normalization not vanish in the high-acceleration limit. The MOND force law is generated by a local auxiliary chi constrained by the vector field, yielding the exact mu(y)=1-e^-y kernel while the vector's stiff nature mediates the necessary off-ray (Psi != Phi) lensing correction without the gradient instabilities of standard AeST.
candidate.predicted_weak_field: In the weak-field limit, the vector field mediates a finite, unscreened PPN alpha_2 (required for MOND lensing), while the MOND-specific coupling to matter is suppressed by e^-y. Because the vector's kinetic normalization is constant (independent of e^-y), the theory avoids the strong-coupling limit (P7) that killed the khronometric and AeST candidates. The lapse-weighted terms are absent, preserving the constraint algebra and preventing the H_perp demotion that plagued DC-003.
candidate.inequivalence_argument: This is inequivalent to DC-001 (frameless) because it explicitly uses a preferred-frame vector. It is inequivalent to DC-002 (AeST) because the vector is degenerate (second-class) rather than standard (6-DOF), and the MOND screening is local e^-y rather than a constant K_B. It is inequivalent to DC-010 (khronometric) because the degenerate vector provides a finite kinetic normalization for the frame mode, separating the screened PPN response from the kinetic normalization, whereas the khronon in DC-010 had a kinetic term tied to the screened sector.

kill_certificate.certificate: preferred-frame coupling with no e^-y screening (P2: AeST/disformal kill); preferred-frame coupling with no e^-y screening (P2: AeST/disformal kill)
